audit_loop: candidate PR generated for an issue
separate reviewer agent explores repository and patch
reviewer emits approve/reject decision plus structured feedback
rejected patch returns to the original PR generator for revision
revised patch is re-verified through SWE-bench
revision_protocol: approved patches remain unchanged; rejected patches are revised by the original PR generator for the split; model failures fall back to the original patch
publisher_conclusion: Agentic review continuously improves PRs through iterative review-revision and improves downstream issue resolution relative to one-shot generation and fixed-context review baselines.
vsm_interpretation: The composed benchmark directly exercises a materially distinct complementary reviewer, discrepancy feedback returned to the operating generator for correction, and independent re-verification of the revised artifact. The benchmark-defined organization owns this S3* loop; no execution substrate or PR-generator harness inherits native S3* ownership by association.
